parts.zh: 加州中部一名9岁男孩勇敢地在强水流和冰冷的海水中游泳
M: 是的。我尽可能做了准备
W: 恭喜你!我就知道你能行!我猜你第一次低估了考试的难度
M: 上过了,谢谢。我很高兴现在终于能上路了
W: 你会惊讶的。我还是要当老师

items.stem: What did the boy from Central California do according to the report?

choices.text: He set a record by swimming to and from an island.
choices.zh: 他通过游泳往返一座岛屿创造了一项纪录。

choices.text: He celebrated his ninth birthday on a small island.
choices.zh: 他在一座小岛上庆祝了自己的九岁生日。

choices.text: He visited a prison located on a faraway island.
choices.zh: 他参观了一座位于遥远岛屿上的监狱。

choices.text: He swam around an island near San Francisco.
choices.zh: 他围绕旧金山附近的一座岛屿游了一圈。

items.stem: What did the father do to encourage his son?

choices.text: He doubled the reward.
choices.zh: 他把奖励翻了一倍。

choices.text: He set him an example.
choices.zh: 他为儿子树立了榜样。

choices.text: He cheered him on all the way.
choices.zh: 他一路为儿子加油鼓劲。

choices.text: He had the event covered on TV.
choices.zh: 他让电视台报道了这次活动。

items.stem: What was the purpose of the annual leave bonus in China?

choices.text: To end the one-child policy.
choices.zh: 终止独生子女政策。

choices.text: To encourage late marriage.
choices.zh: 鼓励晚婚。

choices.text: To increase working efficiency.
choices.zh: 提高工作效率。

choices.text: To give people more time to travel.
choices.zh: 给人们更多时间旅行。

items.stem: What do we learn about the new regulations?

choices.text: They will not be welcomed by young people.
choices.zh: 它们不会受到年轻人的欢迎。

choices.text: They will help to popularize early marriage.
choices.zh: 它们将有助于推广早婚。

choices.text: They will boost China's economic growth.
choices.zh: 它们将促进中国的经济增长。

choices.text: They will not come into immediate effect.
choices.zh: 它们不会立即生效。

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: Cleaning service in great demand all over the world.
choices.zh: 清洁服务在全世界需求旺盛。

choices.text: Two ladies giving up well-paid jobs to do cleaning.
choices.zh: 两位女士放弃高薪工作去做清洁。

choices.text: A new company to clean up the mess after parties.
choices.zh: 一家新公司专门清理派对后的狼藉。

choices.text: Cleaners gainfully employed at nights and weekends.
choices.zh: 清洁工在夜间和周末受雇获利。

items.stem: What is a common problem with a house party?

choices.text: It takes a lot of time to prepare.
choices.zh: 准备工作需要花费大量时间。

choices.text: It leaves the house in a mess.
choices.zh: 派对后房子一片狼藉。

choices.text: It makes party goers exhausted.
choices.zh: 派对参加者筋疲力尽。

choices.text: It creates noise and misconduct.
choices.zh: 制造噪音和不当行为。

items.stem: What are Rebecca Foley and Catherine Ashurst planning to do?

choices.text: Hire an Australian lawyer.
choices.zh: 雇用一名澳大利亚律师。

choices.text: Visit the U.S. and Canada.
choices.zh: 访问美国和加拿大。

choices.text: Settle a legal dispute.
choices.zh: 解决一项法律纠纷。

choices.text: Expand their business.
choices.zh: 拓展她们的业务。

items.stem: What did the man do yesterday?

choices.text: He had a driving lesson.
choices.zh: 他上了一节驾驶课。

choices.text: He got his driver's license.
choices.zh: 他拿到了驾照。

choices.text: He took the driver's theory exam.
choices.zh: 他参加了驾驶理论考试。

choices.text: He passed the driver's road test.
choices.zh: 他通过了驾驶路考。

items.stem: Why did he fail the exam the first time?

choices.text: He was not well prepared.
choices.zh: 他准备得不够充分。

choices.text: He did not get to the exam in time.
choices.zh: 他没能及时赶到考场。

choices.text: He was not used to the test format.
choices.zh: 他不适应考试形式。

choices.text: He did not follow the test procedure.
choices.zh: 他没有遵守考试程序。

items.stem: What does the man say about his driving lessons?

choices.text: They are tough.
choices.zh: 它们很难。

choices.text: They are costly.
choices.zh: 它们很贵。

choices.text: They are helpful.
choices.zh: 它们很有帮助。

choices.text: They are too short.
choices.zh: 它们太短了。

items.stem: What does the man hope to do next?

choices.text: Pass his road test the first time.
choices.zh: 第一次就通过路考。

choices.text: Test-drive a few times on highways.
choices.zh: 在高速公路上试驾几次。

choices.text: Find an experienced driving instructor.
choices.zh: 找一位经验丰富的驾驶教练。

choices.text: Earn enough money for driving lessons.
choices.zh: 挣到足够的钱上驾驶课。

items.stem: What does the man want to know?

choices.text: Where the woman studies.
choices.zh: 女士在哪里学习。

choices.text: The acceptance rate at Leeds.
choices.zh: Leeds 的录取率。

choices.text: Leeds' tuition for international students.
choices.zh: Leeds 对国际学生的学费。

choices.text: How to apply for studies at a university.
choices.zh: 如何申请大学学习。

items.stem: What is the man going to do?

choices.text: Apply to an American university.
choices.zh: 申请一所美国大学。

choices.text: Do research on higher education.
choices.zh: 做高等教育方面的研究。

choices.text: Perform in a famous musical.
choices.zh: 在一部著名音乐剧中表演。

choices.text: Pursue postgraduate studies.
choices.zh: 攻读研究生学位。

items.stem: What might qualify the man for a scholarship at Leeds University?

choices.text: His favorable recommendations.
choices.zh: 他良好的推荐信。

choices.text: His outstanding musical talent.
choices.zh: 他杰出的音乐才能。

choices.text: His academic excellence.
choices.zh: 他优异的学业成绩。

choices.text: His unique experience.
choices.zh: 他独特的经历。

items.stem: What is the woman planning to do after graduation?

choices.text: Do a master's degree.
choices.zh: 攻读硕士学位。

choices.text: Settle down in England.
choices.zh: 在英国定居。

choices.text: Travel widely.
choices.zh: 广泛旅行。

choices.text: Teach overseas.
choices.zh: 去海外教书。

items.stem: What does the passage say about ants?

choices.text: They help farmers keep diseases in check.
choices.zh: 它们帮助农民控制疾病。

choices.text: Many species remain unknown to scientists.
choices.zh: 许多种类仍然不为科学家所知。

choices.text: Only a few species cause trouble to humans.
choices.zh: 只有少数种类给人类造成麻烦。

choices.text: They live in incredibly well-organized colonies.
choices.zh: 它们生活在组织极其完善的群落中。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about carpenter ants?

choices.text: They are larger than many other species.
choices.zh: 它们比许多其他种类体型更大。

choices.text: They can cause damage to people's homes.
choices.zh: 它们会对人们的房屋造成损害。

choices.text: They can survive a long time without water.
choices.zh: 它们可以在没有水的情况下长时间存活。

choices.text: They like to form colonies in electrical units.
choices.zh: 它们喜欢在电气设备中形成群落。

items.stem: What can we do to prevent ants from getting into our homes?

choices.text: Deny them access to any food.
choices.zh: 不让它们获取任何食物。

choices.text: Keep doors and windows shut.
choices.zh: 保持门窗关闭。

choices.text: Destroy their colonies close by.
choices.zh: 摧毁附近的蚂蚁群落。

choices.text: Refrain from eating sugary food.
choices.zh: 避免食用含糖食物。

items.stem: What is the focus of the speaker's research?

choices.text: The function of the human immune system.
choices.zh: 人体免疫系统的功能。

choices.text: The cause of various auto-immune diseases.
choices.zh: 各种自身免疫性疾病的病因。

choices.text: The viruses that may infect the human immune system.
choices.zh: 可能感染人体免疫系统的病毒。

choices.text: The change in people's immune system as they get older.
choices.zh: 人们的免疫系统随着年龄增长而发生的变化。

items.stem: What are the volunteers asked to do in the research?

choices.text: Report their illnesses.
choices.zh: 报告他们的疾病情况。

choices.text: Offer blood samples.
choices.zh: 提供血液样本。

choices.text: Act as research assistants.
choices.zh: 担任研究助理。

choices.text: Help to interview patients.
choices.zh: 帮助采访患者。

items.stem: What does the speaker say will be the impact of his research?

choices.text: Strengthening people's immunity to infection.
choices.zh: 增强人们对感染的免疫力。

choices.text: Better understanding patients' immune system.
choices.zh: 更好地理解患者的免疫系统。

choices.text: Helping improve old people's health conditions.
choices.zh: 帮助改善老年人的健康状况。

choices.text: Further reducing old patients' medical expenses.
choices.zh: 进一步降低老年患者的医疗费用。

items.stem: What did Ted Komada notice one day after he started teaching at Killip Elementary?

choices.text: His students had trouble getting on with each other.
choices.zh: 他的学生们彼此相处有困难。

choices.text: A lot of kids stayed at school to do their homework.
choices.zh: 很多孩子放学后留在学校做作业。

choices.text: His students were struggling to follow his lessons.
choices.zh: 他的学生们难以跟上他的课程。

choices.text: A group of kids were playing chess after school.
choices.zh: 一群孩子放学后在下国际象棋。

items.stem: What are dozens of students from Komada's school going to do this week?

choices.text: Visit a chess team in Nashville.
choices.zh: 访问 Nashville 的一支国际象棋队。

choices.text: Join the school's chess team.
choices.zh: 加入学校的国际象棋队。

choices.text: Participate in a national chess competition.
choices.zh: 参加全国国际象棋比赛。

choices.text: Receive training for a chess competition.
choices.zh: 接受国际象棋比赛的培训。

items.stem: What do we learn about the students of Killip Elementary?

choices.text: Most of them come from low-income families.
choices.zh: 他们大多数来自低收入家庭。

choices.text: Many have become national chess champions.
choices.zh: 许多人成为了全国国际象棋冠军。

choices.text: A couple of them have got involved in crimes.
choices.zh: 他们中有几个人曾卷入犯罪。

choices.text: Many became chess coaches after graduation.
choices.zh: 许多人毕业后成为了国际象棋教练。

items.stem: What have the students learned from Komada?

choices.text: Actions speak louder than words.
choices.zh: 行动胜于言辞。

choices.text: Think twice before taking action.
choices.zh: 三思而后行。

choices.text: Translate their words into action.
choices.zh: 将言辞转化为行动。

choices.text: Take action before it gets too late.
choices.zh: 在为时已晚之前采取行动。
